gen-flavors-gf-winky-sans: Stubby, swaggering and a bit goofy, Flavors puts its towering lowercase up front while Winky Sans stays low and plain sans behind it. Height is the whole story.
gen-flavors-gf-yantramanav: Chunky and playful, Flavors looks drawn with one tip. Yantramanav follows in sans-serif, its tall lowercase huddled close and quietly tidy beside the heading's bold, wobbly swagger.
gen-flavors-outfit: Flavors has a towering lowercase, with diagonals as hefty as its stems, giving every headline a stubby, pencil-stroke swagger. And Outfit, in sans-serif, drops to a moderate height, its cable-like curves finishing early so paragraphs feel open and friendly.
gen-flavors-plus-jakarta-sans: Whimsical and commanding, Flavors stands tall on its towering lowercase, while Plus Jakarta Sans settles into a moderate height beneath it. Its sans-serif lines read smooth and precise.
gen-flavors-space-grotesk: Flavors towers on a stubby, pencil-stroke lowercase, with diagonals as hefty as its stems and a whimsical, commanding streak. Space Grotesk takes over below at a moderate height, its ribbon-like sans-serif strokes giving the heading room to show off.
gen-fredoka-fs-amulya: Amulya reads contemporary and generous, its sans curves leaving wide gaps that make text feel easy to enter. Fredoka heads the page with a steady technical-pen line and a friendly open e, softening the transition.
gen-fredoka-fs-asap: Asap reads sturdy and approachable, its open-arc c forms and near-capital lowercase height keeping every line crisp and legible. Over a longer stretch it stays quick to follow.
gen-fredoka-fs-epilogue: Fredoka draws each round letter with a single pen line and an open e that smiles back at you. Epilogue then adds a tall-bodied sans lowercase with wire-like strokes and stubby ascender tips, a livelier partner.
gen-fredoka-fs-public-sans: Soft, round and friendly, Fredoka traces every glyph with one thickness. Public Sans backs it with a hefty lowercase and broad open counters in sans-serif, making the pair feel trustworthy and approachable.
gen-fredoka-fs-spline-sans: Fredoka's pen line holds one width throughout, and its open e leaves a clear gap. Spline Sans follows as a plain sans with wide curve gaps and uniform strokes, keeping the friendly heading company without competing.
